To work at TBNR Productions you must have a passion for YouTube with a drive to continuously grow and deliver the latest and greatest content!

Part investigative researcher, part creative writer, and 100% YouTube consumer, the Content Writer will be responsible for the ideation, research, and execution of highly engaging Reaction compilations. They will also write light hearted and funny outlines for talent to follow in each episode for our PrestonReacts YouTube channel.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re seeking someone who’s overly passionate about digital content and creators on YouTube, Tiktok, and Instagram Reels. The ideal candidate is genuinely excited to keep up with the latest multi-platform trends and is looking for an opportunity to make a name for themselves in the YouTube community.

Part investigative researcher, part creative writer, and 100% YouTube consumer, the Content Writer will be responsible for the ideation, research, and execution of highly engaging Reaction compilations. They will also write light hearted and funny outlines for talent to follow in each episode.

The ideal candidate is a YouTube junkie who understands how to make relevant content for the current generation of viewer, loves comedy, and wants to help guide the creative ship for one of the leading Content Production companies in the creator game!

WHO YOU ARE

  • YouTube obsessed and likes to have fun and be weird
  • A solutions oriented problem solver who isn't afraid of radical candor
  • A continued learner and seeker of further education to pursue growth
  • An excellent collaborator who fuels excitement
  • Someone who isn’t afraid to ask questions and spark change within themself and the Company
  • Someone with a positive disposition who learns from failure and recognizes wins

YOUR DIRECT RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify relevant compilation topics that will drive high engagement
  • Research and write outline and scripts
  • Craft compelling narratives that elevate the viewing experience and keep audiences engaged
  • Take feedback and edits gracefully and independently revise content to meet brand needs
  • Assist in putting together and maintaining our content strategy
  • Assist with production of shoots to ensure the creative vision comes to life
  • Help review and approve various assets including graphics and thumbnails
  • Quality control of final exports
  • Conduct content safety checks
  • Use YouTube Analytics to understand why things succeed or fail and make adjustments as needed

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2 years of experience with creative writing within the digital media space
  • Stellar writing skills, with a funny, sarcastic, clever voice that will easily adapt itself to the TBNR brand
  • Strong initiative and the ability for creative thinking as it relates to Pop Culture and content production
  • Ability to deliver content on tight deadlines
  • Experience using Google Suite, Monday.com (or other project management tools), and Slack preferred
  • On top of content being produced by competitors and like-minded brands
  • Deep understanding of YouTube backend
  • Must be organized and detail oriented

TBNR’s targeted total compensation rate for a full-time Creative Writer based in Dallas, Texas is between $50,000 and $60,000, which depends on experience, expertise, internal equity within the organization, location, and alignment with market data. Do you believe your skills are trailblazing and merit higher compensation? Still apply! If we agree, we’re willing to negotiate. In addition to compensation, below you’ll find a few of our fire perks:

FIRE PERKS (full time employees only)

  • 100% Company paid Medical Insurance
  • Company sponsored Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401K with a 3% non-elective contribution from TBNR LLC that fully vests immediately
  • Flexible time off with 8 Company paid holidays

TBNR LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment.

title: Supervisor(a) de Produção
description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

Job Description

Job Description
O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Aqui cuidamos da gestão de dados e do desenvolvimento dos nossos produtos digitais como Globoplay, Globo.com, família G (G1, Ge, Gshow) e Cartola, visando a melhor experiência de consumo, interação e relacionamento com os nossos usuários.
Sobre a área
O time de Digital Analytics faz parte da estrutura de Data&AI e atua como um pilar estratégico para a avaliação da performance dos produtos digitais da Globo, como Globoplay, Cartola, GE, G1, entre outros. Nosso trabalho possibilita o entendimento do comportamento dos usuários e o impacto das iniciativas de negócio, fornecendo insumos valiosos para tomada de decisão e avaliação da efetividade das estratégias da empresa. Somos responsáveis por garantir a qualidade, governança e acessibilidade dos dados digitais, assegurando que a coleta esteja bem estruturada, confiável e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.
Diversidade:
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.
Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ, SP ou POA/RS)
Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar a definição e a manutenção do framework de eventos (Ex: GA4, GTM, Amplitude), promovendo reuso e padronização na coleta de dados entre produtos e squads;
  • Garantir a governança da implementação de eventos, taxonomias, documentação e versionamento;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com stakeholders das áreas de produto, marketing, tecnologia e dados, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em estratégias de mensuração consistentes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e promovendo padronização entre os times de produto;
  • Apoiar a integração de ferramentas de mensuração com plataformas de dados e marketing, promovendo interoperabilidade e consistência nas entregas;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias e recorrentes com foco em comportamento do usuário, eficiência de funcionalidades e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Fomentar a cultura orientada a dados, promovendo boas práticas, capacitação técnica e troca de conhecimento entre os profissionais alocados em diferentes frentes.

Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital, como Google Analytics 4 e Google Tag Manager;
  • Vivência na implementação e manutenção de estruturas de eventos e tags em ambientes com múltiplos produtos ou squads;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com análise de grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery ou tecnologias similares;
  • Conhecimento em processos de governança e documentação de dados (eventos, taxonomia, tracking plan);
  • Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e fomentar boas práticas entre diferentes times;
  • Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente, mantendo visibilidade e consistência nas entregas.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital - Amplitude;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker, Looker Studio (Data Studio) ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, pipelines e integrações com plataformas de marketing;
  • Noções de JavaScript, debugging de eventos e ferramentas de inspeção (DevTools, Tag Assistant);
  • Experiência em atuação em estruturas de plataforma ou áreas de competência (chapter, center of excellence);
  • Vivência com governança de eventos, taxonomias e documentação técnica em escala;
  • Experiência com criação de frameworks reutilizáveis de coleta e análise de dados.

title: Especialista de ITAM – Hardware Asset Management (HAM)
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional orientado(a) a resultados e com atenção a detalhes para atuar comoEspecialista de ITAM , com forte foco em Gestão de Ativos de Hardware (HAM) , dentro de nossa equipe de Serviços Gerenciados . A função será responsável pelo suporte operacional diário, execução de processos e garantia de qualidade dos dados em ambientes de clientes, utilizando as plataformas ServiceNow ITSM/ITAM ou Flexera One .
Esta posição desempenha um papel fundamental na governança, conformidade e desempenho dos ativos de hardware ao longo de seu ciclo de vida — desde a aquisição até a baixa — apoiando áreas como compras, estoque, distribuição, manutenção e descarte.
Responsabilidades Principais
• Executar e monitorar os processos degestão de ciclo de vida de ativos de hardware , conforme as melhores práticas ITIL e ISO/IEC 19770.
• Manter e reconciliar osinventários de ativos de hardware , garantindo precisão e integridade nos registros (ServiceNow, Flexera, ERP, UEM, etc.).
• Operar as plataformasServiceNow ITAM/HAM ou Flexera One , realizando a gestão de registros de ativos, almoxarifados e transições de status.
• Processar movimentações, alocações, devoluções, descartes e atividades de renovação de ativos, com base em workflows e automações estabelecidas.
• Apoiar atividades denormalização, deduplicação e limpeza de dados , assegurando qualidade das informações e alinhamento com o CMDB.
• Executar auditorias periódicas, conciliações e relatórios para garantir conformidade com contratos e políticas internas.
• Interagir com áreas de compras, logística, suporte de campo e operações de TI para garantir o atendimento dos pedidos e manutenções.
• AcompanharSLA de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço envolvidos com o suporte a hardware.
• Apoiar o onboarding de novos clientes ou unidades, incluindo carga inicial de dados, definição de perfis de ativos e parametrização de processos.
• Elaborar e manterprocedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) , contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.


Requisitos Desejados
• Graduação em TI, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência prática com ITAM/HAM , preferencialmente em ambiente de serviços gerenciados ou multi-clientes.
• Sólido conhecimento prático das plataformasServiceNow ITSM/ITAM/HAM ou Flexera One .
• Familiaridade com frameworks de governança comoISO/IEC 19770 , ITIL ou CSDM .
• Domínio de Excel, ferramentas de relatórios e integrações com CMDB/ERP.
• Capacidade de analisarnotas fiscais, garantias, cronogramas de depreciação e contratos de ativos .
• Desejável experiência com ferramentas de UEM/Discovery (ex.: SCCM, Intune, JAMF, Tanium, Lansweeper).
• Perfil analítico, boa comunicação, capacidade de resolução de problemas.
• Inglês fluente (espanhol são diferenciais positivos).
Certificações Desejáveis
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – HAM / ITAM
• Fundamentos do ServiceNow ITSM ou ITOM
• Certificação Flexera – Flexera One ITAM
• ITIL v4 Foundation
• ISO/IEC 19770-1 Awareness ou Practitioner
Modelo de Trabalho e Ferramentas
• Gestão de chamados: ServiceNow, Jira ou plataforma do cliente
• Colaboração: Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint
• Relatórios: Performance Analytics (ServiceNow), Excel, Power BI

Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview


The Security Analyst I serves as Tier 1-2 Analyst member of the Bunge Global SOC and all operational activities that serve to protect the confidentiality, integrity and security management of business and employee information and systems in compliance with organization policies and standards. He/she will focus on structured tasks associated with proactive response, initial identification and remediation of suspicious network and host based activity. The successful candidate will have significant and demonstrated skills in the areas of: TCP/IP protocols; malware and virus behavior. The candidate should display strong technical depth that spans PC and server software, application and custom code. A solid technical background in computer vulnerabilities, attack vectors and exploits is required.

Essential Functions


Perform as part of the CTDO group, initial analysis, triage and response tasks of cyber events with the security team to operate a global SOC for Bunge to safeguard the company's assets, intellectual property and information systems.
Conduct Tier 1 SOC activities to collect, store, and correlate, analyze, identify and respond to security data derived from sensors.
Implement, configure, and optimize the detection and reporting capabilities of company’s global security tool suite.
Collect and analyze intrusion artifacts (e.g., event logs, source code, malware) and use discovered data to support incident response actions.
Conduct rapid incident response activities and cyber event investigations.
Conduct a level of critical thinking as it relates to root cause analysis of actual or suspected security incidents recommended corrective actions.
Provide and or contribute to the development of ad-hoc information security reports to be shared with the Information Security Working Group and other executive leadership, as required

Qualifications


Preferred candidate has 1-4+ years’ experience in the Information Technology field
Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience in Cyber Security, SOC operations, Incident Response, and Security tool integration & operations is required.
1+ years direct experience with Splunk, Fidelis, Falcon Host, Firewall and IDS/IPS technologies preferred.
1-2+ year in any position: system administrator, application developer, database administrator, LAN administrator.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree of Science in computer science, information systems, engineering, or programming
Industry recognized certifications such as, GSEC, GCIA, CEH. CISCO a plus
Intermediate scripting knowledge in Perl, PHP, ASP or Java with recent and basic programming experience as a plus
Minimum of 2 years of experience in compliance-oriented industry is preferred.
Advanced understanding and demonstrated technical skils and abilities in the technical information security operations domain
Ability to conduct analysis of multiple data sources and provide assessment on the relationship between threats, vulnerability and information value in the context of risk management for company.
Bi-lingual/Multi-lingual candidates preferred: English Advanced Spanish (Plus).
Solid understanding of the concept of risk-based decision-making (i.e. risk analysis, mitigation, resolution)
Ability to perform high-quality work, work with minimum supervision and deliver results in timely manner.
Must be able to communicate effectively regarding security, privacy, risk, and compliance to senior business leaders and fellow team members.
Able to draw upon proven experience to rapidly assimilate, understand, evaluate and recommend response actions to a variety of cyber events. He/she must be able to work with others in formal and ad-hoc team environments.
Demonstrated ability to configure, maintain and use core tools SPLUNK, Carbon Black or Fidelis.
This individual will have the proven ability to conduct event analysis and correlation; establish facts and deliver conclusions/recommendation under extremely short timelines.
Improve Bunge's outcomes by making data-driven decisions, keeping the customer at the forefront of all they do, and proactively gaining insight into the global strategy.
Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.
Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

Queremos que você se sinta muito mais que número e resultados e, se quiser fazer parte de um time que tem como objetivo transformar as relações de carreira e vida pessoal, seu lugar é aqui.

Engenheiro de Dados Sênior

Procuramos um profissional com expertise em ferramentas gerenciadas do Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e sólida compreensão de DataOps e SRE para integrar nosso time de dados. O papel envolve construir, otimizar e garantir a confiabilidade de pipelines de dados, utilizando BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Composer e outras ferramentas do GCP. É essencial ter forte capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas, com foco em automação, inovação e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

  1. Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis no GCP, com foco em ferramentas como BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform e Composer.
  2. Desenvolver arquiteturas de dados modernas no GCP, incluindo datalakes e data warehouses, usando Cloud Storage, Dataproc e Data Catalog.
  3. Orquestrar pipelines complexos com Composer, aproveitando o Apache Airflow.
  4. Realizar ETL de dados de diversas fontes, utilizando Dataflow e outras ferramentas de integração do GCP.

  6. Garantir a qualidade dos dados com processos de validação e limpeza usando Dataform e outras ferramentas.

  9. Colaborar com engenheiros, cientistas de dados e analistas para soluções integradas.
  10. Implementar pipelines seguindo os princípios de DataOps, com foco em automação, CI/CD.
  11. Aplicar práticas de SRE para garantir confiabilidade, disponibilidade e escalabilidade, monitorando incidentes.
  12. Desenvolver ferramentas para automação de tarefas operacionais, como monitoramento e recuperação de falhas.
  13. Manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias em engenharia de dados, DataOps e SRE no ecossistema GCP.
  14. Participar na construção de uma cultura data-driven na empresa, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados.

  • Prepare and present findings, reports, and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels of the organization

  • Proficiency in process mining tools (e.g., Celonis , UiPath Process Mining, etc.)

  • Good understanding of the Managed Solution business as well as the portfolio of products and solutions used to support platforms and services

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

  • Familiarity with automation technologies and methodologies (e.g., RPA, BPM) is well considered

  • Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL) is an advantage

Histórico comprovado na liderança de projetos complexos, atuando tanto na estratégia(definição do que fazer) quanto na execução(como é a experiência), em ambientes multidisciplinares.

Para esta posição, sugerimos atuação híbrida, e é esperado que você vá pelo menos 2 vezes na semana ao nosso escritório. Nosso escritório é um lugar lindo e inspirador e fica na Av. Rebouças, 3535, em São Paulo, no bairro de Pinheiros. Se tiver curiosidade, só dar uma espiada aqui .

Na Alice, Design é uma disciplina unificada que inclui diferentes especialidades, como Product Design e Creative Design. Acreditamos que essa é a melhor forma de trazer consistência e manter uma visão integrada da nossa nossa experiência..


A especialidade de Product Design tem um papel fundamental na estratégia do negócio. Buscamos criar a melhor jornada possível com o produto e garantir o engajamento dos nossos membros. Dessa forma, quem usa Alice navega melhor pelo sistema de saúde, usa o serviço de forma eficiente e consequentemente se torna mais saudável. Nós estamos revolucionando o mercado de saúde no Brasil. Enquanto os comportamentos de consumo vêm evoluindo de forma acelerada, a experiência das pessoas com planos de saúde é a mesma de 20 anos atrás. Atritos, burocracia, demora para autorizar exames e para marcar consultas, reajustes exorbitantes. O plano é apenas um seguro financeiro reativo.

Somos um plano de saúde empresarial que sabe de saúde. Impulsionado por AI, garantimos que os nossos membros recebam o cuidado certo, no momento certo e no local certo. Proporcionamos uma jornada de saúde que é fácil de acessar, envolvente e extremamente confiável, realizando assim uma gestão proativa da saúde.

A Alice proporciona uma experiência de saúde integrada que já foi escolhida por mais de 8.000 empresas e é hoje o plano de mais de 45.000 pessoas. Junte-se a nós em nossa missão de tornar o mundo mais saudável. Você será parte fundamental na construção de um sistema de saúde mais sustentável que possa ser acessível para mais pessoas.

Trabalhe com paixão pelo propósito, fazendo da missão da Alice a sua missão;

Vá pra Arena e busque ser protagonista, desafiando o status-quo e tendo atitude e coragem de quem quer mudar;

Esteja subindo a barra e evoluindo todos os dias, para entregar o melhor que é possível sonhar;

Se importe com as pessoas, genuinamente, entendendo seus problemas com empatia e ajudando a resolvê-los;

Valorize trabalhar em um ambiente aberto, inclusivo e transparente, onde se possa ser quem verdadeiramente é;

Priorize a sua saúde e felicidade, afinal um time mais saudável gera mais valor.

Somos uma Healthtech fundada em 2019 com o propósito de tornar o mundo mais saudável; o que isso quer dizer, na prática, é que estamos trabalhando duro todos os dias para construir o que um sistema de saúde eficiente e humano deveriam ser.

Não é sobre usar tecnologia para um problema irrelevante ou pequeno, mas sim, repensar como a tecnologia deveria ser usada para gerar mais saúde e mais cuidado para as pessoas

Saúde está entre os maiores desafios da nossa geração: experiência subótima, baixos resultados na geração de saúde e custo exponencialmente crescente.

Alice é um novo capítulo em planos de saúde, implementando uma abordagem de cuidado coordenado e continuado, através de metodologias e tecnologias próprias, pensadas com o Membro no centro das decisões.

title: Dental Product Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

The Dental Product Manager plays a key role in developing, supporting, implementing and managing our dental insurance products to meet market needs, drive growth, and enhance member value. This role champions innovation by identifying and implementing forward-thinking solutions that differentiate our dental product portfolio while serving as the product subject matter expert, working cross-functionally with underwriting, sales, marketing, digital, legal, state filing, compliance, government relations and clinical teams to ensure product competitiveness, compliance and success. The areas of focus for this role includes, but is not limited to: business case development, supporting the development and implementation of the dental products and services, defining and overseeing the go-to-market activities, and supporting all current/inforce dental products, services and capabilities.
You Will:

  • Contribute to the development of a clear product vision and roadmap that is aligned with Guardian’s goals and objectives.
  • Assess key market factors, including competitive landscape, consumer and policyholder insights, and unmet customer needs to identify areas of opportunity for differentiated dental product or service enhancements to meet customer expectations and achieve growth for Guardian.
  • Support monitoring and participating in industry trade groups, meetings and other activities and sharing key learnings with all internal stakeholders.
  • Accountability for monitoring KPIs to ensure proper adoption and performance outcomes are achieved.
  • Work independently but also collaborates with the rest of the product managers and matrix partners to identify opportunities and deliver on shared initiatives.
  • Communicate effectively by articulating information in a manner that is easily understood, both internally and externally, across all levels of the organization and in large public forums.
  • Support negotiations with vendor partners, and influences stakeholders across multiple teams and departments.
  • Execute product management processes throughout the product lifecycle, including product development, roadmap planning, and launch activities.
  • Ensure that procedures and systems are updated as necessary and that changes are communicated to all interested parties.
  • Conduct regular market research and analysis to keep abreast of trends and adapt to the ever-changing market environment.
  • Deliver and present reports, product plans, and competitive analyses to internal stakeholders.
  • Support the development of compelling presentations and documentation. This includes representing Guardian in Thought Leadership webinars and speaking engagements, broker meetings and roadshows, industry associations, etc.
  • Responsible for developing and delivering product training and communication—both internally and externally—to ensure clear, consistent, and accurate messaging that supports the value proposition and effectively educates distribution partners and key stakeholders on product positioning.
You Have:
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in product management, preferably in claims, account management, implementation, and/or product management.
  • Direct dental group insurance experience.
  • The ability to contribute to the development of a clear product vision and translate that vision into actionable product roadmaps.Produces clear supporting documents in PowerPoint, Excel, etc.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities.
  • Fosters a high level of teamwork and collaboration between employees, teams, across departments and the field as appropriate.
  • Possesses excellent organizational skills.
  • Exhibits analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable using metrics and data to form insights, guide decisions, and measure success.
  • Project management experience with a track record of delivering results on time and within budget.
  • Experience working within a matrixed environment and contributing to cross-functional teams.
  • Entrepreneurial – ability to work independently and under pressure; ability to bring clarity to ideas that may appear unclear or ambiguous in concept.
  • Exhibits financial acumen, analytical skills, ability to analyze and communicate financial information, and support business case development.
  • Knowledge of Agile and Lean product development methodologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, computer science, marketing science or related fields.
Location:
  • Preferred locations: Bethlehem, PA; Boston, MA; or New York, NY
  • Hybrid work arrangement (3+ days in office per week)
  • Approximately 20% travel with the position
Salary Range:
$77,570.00 - $127,430.00
The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

Habilidade na gestão de resíduos e controle de poluição em canteiros de obras.

Experiência na elaboração de relatórios técnicos e no cumprimento de condicionantes ambientais.

Disponibilidade para atuar em campo e em diferentes projetos de obras.

Job Description
Trabalhar com as equipes de vendas, marketing, aplicações tecnológicas e serviços nas oportunidades de negócios identificadas, monitorando a execução de planos de negócios adaptados aos diversos cenários culturais e econômicos da América Latina.
Identificar, classificar, planejar e implementar estratégias e ações adequadas à maturidade dos mercados-alvo e contas, independentemente de as contas estarem em fase de "aquisição" ou "em desenvolvimento".
RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Propor e implementar estratégias abrangentes de desenvolvimento específicas para os mercados atribuídos, a fim de atingir os objetivos comerciais na região, com base em análises de mercado, concorrência, portfólio de soluções, ecossistema de canais, histórias de sucesso e propostas de valor da Vertiv.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado para identificar tendências, necessidades dos clientes e dinâmicas competitivas nos mercados atribuídos na América Latina.
  • Alinhar as estratégias com os objetivos globais da empresa, abordando, ao mesmo tempo, as nuances locais.
  • Identificar e buscar novas oportunidades de negócios nos mercados atribuídos, avaliando novas parcerias, joint ventures e canais de distribuição.
  • Implementar a estratégia de entrada nos mercados/territórios atribuídos, garantindo a cobertura das contas e mercados-alvo para atingir as vendas de produtos e serviços da Vertiv.
  • Implementar a estratégia de desenvolvimento de mercado/território, garantindo o posicionamento da marca para atingir as vendas de todas as linhas de produtos e serviços disponíveis da Vertiv.
  • Liderar esforços de inteligência de mercado para identificar leads e, com o apoio das equipes de marketing e vendas, desenvolver esforços de posicionamento da marca nos segmentos industriais atribuídos.
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos entre a Vertiv e as principais partes interessadas, incluindo entidades governamentais, associações e parceiros comerciais, para facilitar a comunicação, a cooperação e o desenvolvimento do setor.
QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • 5 anos de experiência no setor em operações de vendas, vendas ou marketing.
  • Sólido conhecimento da dinâmica e arquitetura de infraestrutura de setores como Mineração e Materiais, Energia (Óleo e Gás, Serviços Públicos, Energias Renováveis), Saúde, Manufatura, Transporte, Varejo, Serviços Financeiros e Bancos, Educação, Governo, Educação e/ou Telecomunicações.
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação e capacidade de construir relacionamentos diversificados interna e externamente.
  • Habilidades analíticas para identificar mercados com maior potencial e compreender o impacto das mudanças de mercado e da concorrência à medida que afetam um portfólio de produtos.

Role Overview
With the passion of our people, our technology expertise and a broad ecosystem of partners, Accenture is committed to being a sustainable and responsible business, innovating for positive societal and environmental impact, developing and scaling programmes and solutions that help address big challenges for people and planet.
From a Corporate Citizenship perspective, we are currently looking for a passionate and enthusiastic team player to join us as our Collaboration support analyst. This role is designed to lead the on/off boarding process for all new joiners/leavers in the Corporate Citizenship Network, support the engagement activities to strengthen connections and foster collaborations and act as central point of contact to manage general questions and requests from all the team.
The Sr. Analyst will support the Corporate Citizenship in the following areas:
Essential Priorities
Foster Connections and collaboration to increase our Social Impact (support coordination of learning virtual sessions and management of a new regular newsletter for the team).
Through the coordination and delivery of key engagement sessions and communications targeting our entire Corporate Citizenship Team, this role will serve as the central force that brings the team together, creates learning opportunities, and fosters collaboration, knowledge exchange, and connections.
Strengthen engagement, and sense of belonging while establishing and continue building the foundation of our Team Culture and offering learning opportunities (On/Off boarding Process, and CC Mailbox/Accenture Direct questions Management)
This role will support activities aimed at building a strong foundation to enhance the sense of belonging within the team. In addition, it will be essential for this role to serve as a key point of contact (PoC) for our teammates, providing answers to their questions and offering support.
Production of summary updates /presentations, Global Subscriptions management and content management (CC Shared Mailbox, content update and maintenance, support the creation of key ad-hoc presentations and global subscriptions management, and maintenance of SharePoint and MS Teams)
Supporting the creation of engaging and visually appealing slides and presentations for our various virtual sessions (including those requested by leadership) will be a key activity for this role. Additionally, this role will involve managing our content management approach and maintaining key tools, such as SharePoint and MS Teams, to ensure compliance with Information Security requirements.
Qualifications

On/Off Boarding Process

  • Become key point of contact for the network to be aware of all new joiners, leavers and internal rotations.
  • Create, maintain and share onboarding materials, welcome emails and lead induction calls with new joiners ensuring these are included in our distro lists and granted access to key tools as needed.

Network Engagement And Communications
  • Support the coordination and delivery of key engagement sessions with logistics, recording, interaction tools (i.e. Menti), and co-presenting.
  • Support launch of a regular newsletter for the team (including information about different programs, stories, milestones and updates).
  • Monitor and follow up questions and connections happening during engagement sessions.
  • Attendance tracking.
  • Creation and Maintenance of key power point/trackers (i.e. virtual sessions presentations, Case studies; Story Tracker, etc.).
  • Provide ad-hoc support to our network.
Content Management & SharePoint and MS Teams (tool and content) Maintenance:
  • Responsible for the SharePoint structure, content and access maintenance.

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.
Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications
  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.

  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. Street Diligence is a high-growth FinTech start-up with an innovative product offering and ambitious expansion plans. About The Role
Street Diligence Inc. is seeking a dynamic Software Engineering Team Lead to drive the development of high-quality software solutions. This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer with hands-on experience in large web applications & moderate codebases. You should have a solid grasp of modern programming design patterns. You will lead a talented team of engineers, ensuring sprint assignments are efficiently executed while providing technical guidance and architectural vision. Your expertise in architecting scalable solutions will be key to our continued innovation and success.
What You'll Do
Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Team Guidance: Participate in providing technical guidance to software engineers, ensuring that sprint tasks are well-defined, prioritized, and completed on schedule.
  • Code Quality: Conduct regular code reviews and enforce best practices to maintain a robust, clean, and sustainable codebase.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Lead regular technical discussions and workshops to foster continuous learning and development among team members.
Architecture & Design
  • Solution Architecture: Help to design and architect scalable, high-performance solutions that meet both current and future business needs.
  • Design Patterns: Apply and promote proven programming design patterns and best practices across projects, ensuring consistency and maintainability in complex codebases.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with UX/UI designers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to integrate feedback and align on project goals.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring transparency and shared understanding across the organization.
What You'll Bring To The Table
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a proven track record in a leadership or team lead role.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience working with large or complex codebases and a deep understanding of programming design patterns.
  • Proven experience in architecting scalable software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of web application development and modern web design patterns.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Ruby, C#, Java, JavaScript) and familiarity with full-stack development concepts.
  • Strong background in agile development methodologies and continuous integration practices.
Additional Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building innovative solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively mentor and support team members.
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards of code quality, including unit testing and behavior-driven development practices.
This role is a unique opportunity to drive technical excellence, and to help contribute to the evolution of our software architecture. If you’re passionate about engineering leadership and ready to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply.
We know that not everyone will meet all of the qualifications listed above. If your experience doesn't perfectly align, but you believe you'd be a strong fit for the team, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to learn more about what you can offer!

About Azion
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!
At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.
About The Position
We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer (Vue/JS) to join our UX Engineering team at our Porto Alegre office. As part of the UX Engineering team, the successful candidate will be responsible for building and evolving our frontend applications that enable clients to configure and use our products.
Your Impact

  • Build and evolve out frontend applications;
  • Communicate technically with engineering teams, or discuss product features with stakeholders adapting communication speach;
  • Be goal oriented and focused: have strong analytical skills and problem resolution mindset based on data;
  • Be a self learner, but also be able to teach others: you are eager to learn, and take a keen eye on user experience, making sure the user will have a great time using our products;
  • Be flexible in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements. Use AI for everything you can on your day-to-day;
  • Build products you'll be proud: interact with Design, Backend Developers, Product Managers, and other areas.
What You’ll Bring
  • Experience with frontend (HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, Tailwind) and market frameworks (VueJs, Astro, React, Angular, etc);
  • Experience with REST and GQL APIs;
  • Experience with testing tools and layers (Jest, Cypress, PlayWright);
  • Experience with UNIX development environments (we use MacBooks at Azion);
  • Knowledge in state management (pinia, redux, or similar);
  • Knowledge in componentization and good practices for UI and UX;
  • Knowledge in HTTP requests (status codes, headers, etc);
  • Good code organization and knowledge of good practices;
  • Intermediate english (our code base is written in english).
Bonus Points
  • Familiarity with platforms for quickly prototing and deploying (Vercel, Supabase, Cloudflare, or more traditional services like AWS or GCP);
  • Knowledge in good project patterns;
  • Familiarity with storybook;
  • Knowledge in Edge Computing or CDNs;
  • Knowledge in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Understanding of Client-Side APIs (DOM, Storage, XmlHttpRequest etc);
  • Knowledge in CI/CD workloads (Github Actions or similar).
Benefits & Azion Way Of Life
  • CLT hiring model;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;
  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;
  • Annual internal hackathons;
  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);
  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);
  • Stock options (according to policy);
  • Birthday day off;
  • TotalPass;
  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);
  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;
  • Annual international exchange program.
FlexWork Model
We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.
After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.
At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.
Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

description:
As an open pit mine drill and blast subject matter expert, you will work with colleagues at dss+ to improve safety in opening pit mining operations with a specific focus on drill and blast operations.

You’ll save lives, drive performance and improve the working lives of our clients’ employees.

As a freelance specialist in drill and blast operations, you will be expected to provide technical expertise as part of the dss+ team to the client and its employees, whilst supporting a larger transformation project.

Specifically, you will be providing technical advice on drill & blast processes, including:

  • Blast design

  • Explosive selection and handling

  • Drill rigs

  • Risk Assessment methodologies

The project is scheduled to start in September 2025, with onboarding and training taking place from mid-to-late August.


At dss+, we embrace and celebrate diversity. Above all, we are an inclusive culture in which everyone contributes and has the chance to develop their talents further.


As a technical expert with operational experience of risk and safety management in the field of Drill & Blast engineering in open pit mining you will have the following experience and expertise:

Blast Design Expertise:

  • Proficient in designing drill patterns, burden, spacing, subdrill , stemming, and initiation sequences.

  • Deep understanding of blast fragmentation modeling , throw control, and muck pile shaping for loading efficiency.

  • Knowledge of controlled blasting techniques (e.g., presplit, cushion blasting) near pit walls.

Explosives Selection & Handling:

  • Solid experience with ANFO, emulsions, boosters, detonators (Nonel, electronic), and primers .

  • Understanding of explosive energy characteristics and their impact on rock mass fragmentation and vibration.

Initiation Systems:

  • Familiarity with advanced electronic blasting systems , including timing control and vibration management.

  • Ability to evaluate the safety and performance implications of different initiation sequences .

Drill Rigs and Equipment:

  • Knowledge of drill rig capabilities, maintenance, bit selection , and their effect on hole deviation and blasting outcomes.

Risk Assessment Methodologies:

  • Application of Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) , Bowtie , or Hazard Identification (HAZID) techniques.

  • Use of probabilistic or semi-quantitative risk models for evaluating likelihood and impact.

Monitoring and Control Techniques:

  • Interpretation of data from blast monitoring tools : seismographs, high-speed cameras, drone imagery.

  • Knowledge of post-blast audits , including fragmentation analysis (e.g., WipFrag), vibration data, and flyrock trajectory evaluation.

  • Familiarity with ground vibration and airblast prediction models and regulatory thresholds (e.g., NIOSH, ISEE, Brazilian standards).

Due to the multi-national make up of the teams you will be working with, you will need to be able to work in both English and Portuguese at a professional level.

title: ERW Scientist / Researcher Brazil
description:
Location

Goiás, Brazil — On-site near Rio Verde


Desired Knowledge And Experience

  • PhD in Geochemistry, Soil Science, Agronomy, Environmental Science, Geology, or related field.
  • Deep understanding of inorganic & organic soil carbon cycling and silicate dissolution kinetics.
  • Hands-on experience with soil/rock/water sampling and analysis.
  • Track record in designing and running field or mesocosm trials.
  • Portuguese & English fluency; Spanish a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across rural Goiás.

About Us

ZeroEx is scaling permanent carbon removal through enhanced rock weathering (ERW) projects in Germany, Brazil, and the United States. We license cutting-edge measurement tech that verifies every tonne sequestered, opening up the ERW industry to mining and agribusinesses ready to add an additional business model or decarbonize their core business.
Culture is the shadow of people—self-guided missiles who run on trust, ownership, and speed. If you thrive in ambiguity, lead from any seat, and care deeply about climate impact, you’ll feel at home here.


Preferred Skills

  • Geochemical modelling with PHREEQC or GWB.
  • Familiarity with carbon markets or MRV standards.
  • Strong scientific network in ERW-related disciplines.

About The Role

As our on-site ERW Scientist in Brazil, you’ll own all scientific work across current and future projects—translating global research plans into field and lab reality in Goiás. You’ll design trials, run sampling campaigns, and generate the data that underpins our MRV.


What You'll Do

  • Sampling & analysis coordination: plan, schedule, and execute soil, rock, water, and pore-water sampling across multiple sites.
  • Method development: design and refine protocols to measure silicate weathering rates and carbon fluxes.
  • Field trials: set up and oversee mesocosm and in-field experiments; iterate quickly to test new approaches.
  • Data interpretation: collaborate with ZeroEx scientists to analyse results and feed insights back into operations.
  • Networking: build relationships with Brazilian universities, labs, and regulators to accelerate ERW adoption.

Additional Responsibilities Will Include

  • Maintaining detailed SOPs and ensuring QA/QC on all samples.
  • Training field technicians on best-practice sampling methods.
  • Contributing to publications, grant proposals, and conference presentations.

What Makes ZeroEx Special?

  • Mission now, not 2050 – Each tonne removed is verified, permanent, and immediate.
  • On-ground autonomy – You’ll make real-time calls that shape ZeroEx Brazil’s scientific program.
  • Global tight-knit team – Join scientists, founders, and operators who move fast and keep egos low.

description:
Your role at Dynatrace

What’s the role?

As a Dynatrace Log Management and Analytics - Solutions Engineer, you will be a key member of the Dynatrace sales engine and will be responsible for providing excellent technical support to the sales team. You will be the expert on Dynatrace and observability, with a specialization in Log Management and Analytics. Within this exciting role, you will be responsible for executing great demos which demonstrate the Dynatrace unique approach in solving the customer’s pain, executing and managing POCs onsite and remote, building key relationships with Dynatrace’s customers and completing RFIs & RFPs. You will also work across teams including Dynatrace’s innovation labs, Dynatrace’s Expert Services consultants, CSMs and marketing.

About you:

To ensure your success as a Solutions Engineer at Dynatrace, you need to be an ambitious, confident and self-motivated individual, with previous SE experience or another technical customer facing role. You need to be passionate about innovative technology, technical sales and articulating value to customers and prospects. In addition, we are also looking for:

  • An excellent team player, with the ability to work across all disciplines.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical value into business value.
  • Previous 3 – 5 years of experience with log analytics technologies and techniques.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues to produce a working outcome and be able to manage this process.
  • Ability to manage a number of projects simultaneously, work with a number of different sales people and support other SEs.
  • Must have a strong desire to grow professionally, adapt to an ever-changing environment and are coachable.
  • Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time.

Responsibilities:

  • Evangelize Dynatrace’s product offerings during international trade shows and at key customer account meetings to promote new and expanded business.
  • Partner with sales representatives to identify new sales opportunities as well as incremental sales opportunities within existing accounts.
  • As part of the solution engineering team participate in proof of concept (PoC) creation and cloud architecture discussions, leading the technical solution evaluation portion in support of sales opportunities either directly or through channel partners for multiple POCs.
  • Present Dynatrace’s vision to our customers C-suite executives.
  • Provide technical guidance in the Discovery, Solution Evaluation, and Solution Proposal stages of the opportunity sales cycle.
  • Present on-stage demonstrations providing insight and context to our customers during key marketing events.
  • Either at Dynatrace sponsored industry events or partner sponsored events, ensure key demonstrations are delivered by you or a team member at demonstration booths.
  • Gather, qualify and provide feedback from customers to Product Management to improve Dynatrace’s market share and meet the market needs.
  • Build best practices and share knowledge the team to continuously develop and enhance both your personal and team capabilities.
  • Work with local Sales and Sales Engineering leadership to identify learning/ development opportunities for you and the local team to maintain Dynatrace’s leadership position in the market.
  • Create and modify Dynatrace template presentations, in order to attend the specific demands of each customer not only work with internal sales team, but also with partners, supporting their team in the customers and being a technical point of contact for them (trusted advisor/technical coach).
  • Position might be filled at a higher level based on candidate experience.

What will help you succeed

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience with observability and log collectors/pipelines such as FluentBit, OpenTelemetry, Cribl, and Logstash.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with query languages such as SQL, SPL, or KQL.
  • Experience with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Experience with programming / scripting side technologies such as Java, .NET, PHP, Go, Node.js and database.
  • Advanced knowledge of Operating Systems (OS) including Windows and Linux.
  • Experience with DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering practices Knowledge with cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience with modern technologies like containers, Kubernetes / OpenShift, Serverless functions, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with automation like Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, etc.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

  • A one-product software company creating real value for the largest enterprises and millions of end customers globally, striving for a world where software works perfectly.
  • Working with the latest technologies and at the forefront of innovation in tech on scale; but also, in other areas like marketing, design, or research.
  • A team that thinks outside the box, welcomes unconventional ideas, and pushes boundaries.
  • An environment that fosters innovation, enables creative collaboration, and allows you to grow.
  • A globally unique and tailor-made career development program recognizing your potential, promoting your strengths, and supporting you in achieving your career goals.
  • A truly international mindset with Dynatracers from different countries & cultures all over the world, and English as the corporate language that connects us all.
  • A culture that is being shaped by the diverse personalities, expertise, and backgrounds of our global team.

Compensation and Rewards

  • The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $160,000. When determining your salary, we consider your experience, skills, education, and work location.
  • Our total compensation package includes unlimited personal time off, an employee stock purchase plan, and a reward system.

title: Gerente de Cadeias de Valor
description:
Gerente de Cadeias de Valor

Posição: Gerente de Cadeias de Valor

Programa/Departamento: Florestas e Uso da Terra

Esta posição está atualmente hospedada pelo WRI Brasil, dentro do Programa de Florestas e Uso da Terra. O WRI trabalha para desenvolver soluções que garantam a segurança alimentar de 10 bilhões de pessoas até 2050, reduzindo as emissões de gases de efeito estufa, combatendo a perda de florestas e aliviando a pobreza.

O WRI Brasil busca uma pessoa para atuar como Gerente de Cadeias de Valor, liderando iniciativas estratégicas que promovam cadeias produtivas agropecuárias mais sustentáveis, inclusivas e livres de desmatamento e conversão. A posição requer uma combinação de competências técnicas e estratégicas, além de forte capacidade de articulação e engajamento com diversos setores.

Esta função possui como foco transversal o desenvolvimento de soluções e estratégias para reduzir o desmatamento associado às cadeias de valor, especialmente as de soja e carne, atuando para influenciar positivamente as dinâmicas de oferta e demanda entre países, empresas, fornecedores e formuladores de políticas públicas e privadas.

Principais atividades e/ou responsabilidades:

Engajamento e articulação institucional

  • Representar o WRI Brasil em articulações nacionais e internacionais, participando de eventos, coalizões, grupos de trabalho e forças-tarefa relacionados à sustentabilidade das cadeias de valor agropecuárias, com especial atenção às agendas associadas à eliminação do desmatamento e conversão de ecossistemas nas cadeias de soja e carne.
  • Estabelecer e manter parcerias estratégicas com organizações públicas, privadas, multilaterais, academia e sociedade civil, promovendo a colaboração para ações transformadoras que favoreçam cadeias mais responsáveis e transparentes.
  • Promover e fortalecer o uso de ferramentas e tecnologias relacionadas ao uso da terra e à rastreabilidade de cadeias produtivas, Global Forest Watch Pro e outras soluções de monitoramento e verificação aplicadas ao setor agropecuário.
  • Comunicar de forma estratégica os resultados, pesquisas e recomendações do WRI para públicos diversos, incluindo formuladores de políticas e o setor privado, com vistas a influenciar padrões de produção e consumo mais sustentáveis e livres de desmatamento.
  • Trabalhar com outros gerentes da área para gestão compartilhada na estratégia do programa, reportando metas e progressos, bem como liderar a elaboração de propostas e pesquisas com abordagem interdisciplinares.

Gestão do portfólio de projetos

  • Liderar o portfólio de projetos relacionados à promoção de cadeias de valor sustentáveis, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, no prazo e dentro do orçamento, com foco em iniciativas que promovam o monitoramento, a rastreabilidade e a adequação a protocolos setoriais.
  • Desenhar, planejar e implementar estudos e pesquisas que impulsionem a transição agropecuária brasileira para sistemas ambientalmente corretos, socialmente justos e economicamente viáveis, com atenção especial às relações de oferta e demanda em mercados nacionais e internacionais.
  • Identificar e propor políticas e instrumentos financeiros, regulatórios ou de mercado que promovam melhores práticas produtivas e comerciais, tanto para pequenos produtores quanto para cadeias de larga escala, especialmente nos setores de soja e carne.
  • Contribuir com a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e analíticos, artigos científicos e materiais para disseminação de conhecimento, com foco em soluções para eliminar o desmatamento e fomentar a rastreabilidade e a transparência nas cadeias agropecuárias.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento financeiro e gestão de demandas estratégicas e operacionais do programa, bem como, supervisionar relatórios narrativos e financeiros destinados a doadores, garantindo qualidade, precisão e aderência aos requisitos contratuais.
  • Garantir o alinhamento das iniciativas com as estratégias institucionais do WRI Brasil e do WRI Global, particularmente no que tange ao combate ao desmatamento nas cadeias produtivas.

Captação de recursos (fundraising)

  • Identificar oportunidades de financiamento e colaborar com a equipe de Desenvolvimento do WRI Brasil na elaboração de propostas e na negociação com financiadores, com ênfase em projetos voltados à promoção de cadeias livres de desmatamento e à implementação de soluções inovadoras de monitoramento e rastreabilidade.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento do portfólio de projetos da área, alinhado às prioridades estratégicas e à missão do WRI, com foco especial na atuação sobre as cadeias de soja e carne.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos com doadores e parceiros estratégicos, assegurando a sustentabilidade financeira dos projetos de cadeias de valor e ampliando o impacto das ações institucionais.

Gestão de equipe

  • Liderar, supervisionar e inspirar a equipe responsável pelos projetos de cadeias de valor trabalhando em alinhamento com a equipe de RH, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e orientado à excelência, com foco no desenvolvimento de competências relacionadas ao monitoramento e rastreabilidade de cadeias produtivas.
  • Coordenar processos de planejamento, monitoramento e avaliação de desempenho, assegurando a entrega de resultados e o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
  • Gerir processos de mudança e inovação, fortalecendo o comprometimento e superando resistências, especialmente na implementação de soluções que promovam a transparência e a sustentabilidade nas cadeias de valor.
  • Estimular o aprendizado e o intercâmbio de conhecimentos dentro da equipe e com outras áreas do WRI, especialmente no que se refere às dinâmicas de mercado, aos setores produtivos prioritários e às relações comerciais internacionais.
  • Contribuir com iniciativas institucionais e de RH para promoção das políticas e iniciativas da organização junto a equipe

Requisitos e Qualificações necessários

  • Mestrado em áreas como Ciências Ambientais, Agronomia, Economia, Relações Internacionais, Sustentabilidade ou afins.
  • Desejável pelo menos 10 anos de experiência transformando pesquisa e dados em ação, preferencialmente em organizações internacionais sem fins lucrativos.
  • Desejável mínimo de 5 anos em gestão de projetos, idealmente relacionados a cadeias produtivas, ferramentas de dados, análise ou visualização.
  • Experiência consolidada em liderança, gestão de pessoas e processos.
  • Autonomia e capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente, liderando iniciativas estratégicas, incluindo na língua inglesa.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado do contexto brasileiro, incluindo desafios e oportunidades nas cadeias produtivas e políticas públicas relacionadas, com foco especial nas cadeias de soja e carne.
  • Familiaridade com dinâmicas produtivas e comerciais setoriais, bem como com mecanismos internacionais de regulamentação, certificação, verificação e rastreabilidade de cadeias agropecuárias.
  • Entendimento das relações comerciais internacionais e de como elas influenciam a dinâmica de oferta e demanda, especialmente no contexto das commodities agrícolas.
  • Familiaridade com finanças e investimento para a conservação e transformação de sistemas produtivos.
  • Familiaridade com o Acordo de Paris, processos da UNFCCC e implicações para o setor agropecuário.
  • Experiência com publicação de relatórios e artigos técnicos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação eficaz com públicos diversos, incluindo formuladores de políticas, setor privado, academia e sociedade civil.

Como se inscrever

Caso você se qualifique para a vaga, inscreva-se online no site até dia 31 de julho de 2025. Só serão consideradas no processo de seleção inscrições submetidas por este site.

Promoção da Diversidade

O WRI Brasil busca incorporar a diversidade em suas ações e projetos. Por isso, se desejar, indique na sua Carta de Intenções informações que julgar relevantes para consideração em sua candidatura, incluindo, mas não se limitando a: raça/etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, origem regional, vínculo com populações tradicionais, deficiência física ou necessidade específica.

Sobre o WRI Brasil

O WRI Brasil é um instituto de pesquisa que trabalha em parceria para gerar transformação. Atua no desenvolvimento de estudos e implementação de soluções para que as pessoas tenham o essencial para viver, para proteger e restaurar a natureza, pelo equilíbrio do clima e por comunidades resilientes. Alia excelência técnica à articulação política e trabalha com governos, empresas, academia e sociedade civil.

O WRI Brasil faz parte do World Resources Institute (WRI). Fundado em 1982, o WRI conta com cerca de 1,7 mil profissionais pelo mundo, com escritórios em Brasil, China, Colômbia, Índia, Indonésia, México e Estados Unidos, além de escritórios regionais na África e na Europa.

System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking
Our growing investment in Ubuntu now enables us to hire a group of outstanding systems software engineers to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.
The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack. Applicants will be comfortable discussing bridges, bonds, routing, DNS resolution and other technologies used to interconnect modern operating systems. We'll work with a very wide range of upstream components and communities covering a wide range of connectivity tech. We might touch the kernel, iwd, networkmanager, wpa_supplicant, bluetooth stacks, conman, mobile data stacks, ethernet, infiniband, network virtualisation capabilities, VPNs and offload to smartnics. We model Ubuntu connectivity with Netplan and will continue to drive this forward as the easiest and most effective central tool to enable connectivity everywhere.
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers and maintains the core of the Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest and best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer industry.
As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
